# Exeevo

> Exeevo is a unified, AI-powered life sciences CRM built natively on Microsoft (Dynamics 365, Power Platform and Azure). It gives commercial, medical and marketing teams at pharma and MedTech companies one system, one data model and one license. Exeevo is a division of Valsoft.

Customer data is stored and processed in the customer's own Microsoft Azure environment. It is not sold, shared or used to train AI models across other customers.

## Key pages
- [Home](/): what Exeevo is and who it is for (a Microsoft-native, purpose-built CRM for life sciences), why reps adopt it (offline-first mobile app, voice capture, Ask-Nova call briefs), one licence instead of a stack, purpose-built moments versus a generic CRM, the eight modules, and the two go-live paths
- [Platform](/platform): eleven capabilities in one view, filterable by industry (Pharma, MedTech, Consumer Health) and by who uses them: Field Sales, Account Management, Medical Affairs, Marketing and Omnichannel, Events, Content and MLR, Compliance and Transparency, Insights and Analytics, Ask-Nova, Retail Execution (Consumer Health), Cases, Assets and Kits (MedTech); available on web, tablet, phone and offline. Filtered views: /platform?industry=pharma, /platform?industry=medtech, /platform?industry=consumer-health, /platform?role=field-rep, /platform?role=msl, /platform?role=kam
- [Why Exeevo](/why-exeevo): built natively for life sciences, regulatory and compliance coverage, comparison with generic CRM platforms and point-solution add-ons
- [Ask-Nova Studio & AI](/ask-nova): thirteen AI features grouped by who uses them and when (AI Summaries, AI Insights, Conversation Analysis, Embedded Note Taker, Companion App, Ask-Nova Assistant, Voice Interaction, Multi-Language Support, Ask-Nova Studio, Data Connectivity, MCP Server, AI Configurator, AI Support Tool); three come with every licence, Ask-Nova Plus adds the rest; answers are grounded in the customer's data, not trained on it
- [Professional Services](/services): advisory, implementation, data migration, integrations, training, managed services, hosting, AI enablement and machine learning services, grouped as Consult, Implement and Operate; includes the Core (live in as little as 4 weeks) and Enterprise launch paths and the "Talk to our team" demo and enquiry form
- [Resources](/resources): blog, white papers, webinars, case studies, press releases, events, analyst reports and a glossary of life sciences terms
- [Glossary](/glossary): plain-language definitions (HCP, MSL, KAM, MLR, 21 CFR Part 11 and more)
- [About](/about): company story (founded 2017, part of Valsoft since December 2024), what Exeevo does, leadership team (Ludovic Petit, CEO; Reeba Thomas, Head of People; Vivek Iyer, Head of IT and AI Initiatives; Lokesh Shetty, Head of Professional Services; Simmya Velutan, Head of R&D; Raja Somasekhar Gupta, Director – Finance & Accounts), offices in Clearwater (US), Montreal (Canada), Bangalore (India) and Shanghai (China), team members in the United Kingdom and Portugal
- [Built on Microsoft](/microsoft): the Microsoft stack Exeevo CRM runs on (Power Platform, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Customer Insights, Dataverse, Power Automate, Power BI, Entra ID, Azure Functions and SQL, Data Lake, Fabric, Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, Azure Monitor, Azure regions) and why a Microsoft foundation matters

## Professional Services (10 services)
- Consult: Consulting & Solution Advisory; AI Readiness & Advisory
- Implement: Implementation; Data Migration & Data Operations; Integrations & Connectivity; Training & Enablement
- Operate: Managed Services; Hosting & Platform Operations; AI Enablement Services; Machine Learning Services

## The eight modules
- Sales CRM: HCP targeting and segmentation, territory alignment, call planning and sample compliance
- Medical CRM: scientific plans, adverse event and medical inquiry case management, KOL engagement tracking
- Marketing Automation: omnichannel HCP journeys, segment building and campaign reporting
- Event Management: virtual, hybrid and in-person events with native Microsoft Teams webinars
- Content Management: compliant digital asset management with MLR review in Microsoft Teams, e-signatures and audit trails
- Customer Insights: unified customer profile with out-of-box churn, lifetime value and sentiment models
- Mobile App: offline-capable, voice-to-text capture and geo-routing for field reps, MSLs and account managers
- Ask-Nova Studio: build and configure AI agents scoped to the customer's own data and compliance guardrails

## Compliance coverage
FDA 21 CFR Part 11 (audit trails and e-signatures), GDPR (consent and data-subject controls), PIPL (data residency and localization for China), HIPAA and Sunshine Act (transparency reporting and PHI safeguards).
